usedFor: Factures holds invoices and contacts, and “Invoive Paid” and “New Invoice” start steps when billing changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Invoive Paid” in Factures
bestTemplate.why: It tells you when an invoice status becomes paid, so the next step can start from payment.

watchOut: “Invoive Paid” is polling, so it runs on a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
